Write docs/pre-release-remediation.md (referenced by code/docs)
evidence: docs/pre-release-remediation.md: 14 items, resolves all dangling references

decisions.summary: Numbering in docs/pre-release-remediation.md is load-bearing: items 1,3,5,6,11 are cited by exact number from README.md, SECURITY.md, src/cli.ts, src/core.ts, install.sh, session-start.sh and install_regression_test.sh. Never renumber.
Deleting hooks/hooks.json was correct: nothing referenced it, and install.sh writes hook config into settings.json inline, so it was a dead second source of truth.

The store lock covers all mutating CLI commands, not just --expect-rev, because SECURITY.md/README promised general serialization. Read-only and unknown commands stay unlocked so status on an uninitialized project does not create .claude-task/.

next_action: Watch CI on branch fofxjc-pre-release-remediation — it now runs all 8 suites on Node 18/20/22 for the first time, so a failure there is new signal, not a regression. Do not tag v0.1.0 without the user's go-ahead.
